description: 13-week cash-flow forecast. Returns current bank balance, projected weekly inflows/outflows/running balance for the next 13 weeks, projected low point, recurring patterns detected from history, outstanding invoices expected to clear, recurring invoice projections, and tax deadlines that could draw cash. Use when the user asks about cashflow, runway, "can I afford X", "when will I run out", or wants to plan ahead.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

name: get_cash_flow_forecast
title: Get Cash Flow Forecast
